en: Udāna 5.9 Sadhāyamānasutta Thus have I heard:
On one occasion the Blessed One was wandering on tour among the Kosalans together with a large community of bhikkhus.
Now at that time, several young brahmins were passing by not far from the Blessed One, making a great noise.
The Blessed One saw those several young brahmins passing by nearby, making a great noise.
Then the Blessed One, having understood this matter, on that occasion uttered this inspired exclamation:
“Those who appear wise are actually deluded,
speaking only within the range of mere words.”
As far as they desire the extent of their mouths,
they do not know that by which they have been led.
